stories.title: Nach Notruf: US-Küstenwache findet Trümmerteile von vermisstem Kleinflugzeug

en.title: After distress call: US Coast Guard finds debris from missing small aircraft
en.summary: A small aircraft carrying six people declared an emergency while flying from Bermuda to Boston before losing contact. Debris from the aircraft was later discovered off the US coast.

stories.title: Notfälle: US-Küstenwache findet Trümmerteile von vermisstem Flugzeug

en.title: Emergencies: US Coast Guard finds debris from missing aircraft
en.summary: The US Coast Guard located wreckage from a missing aircraft.

stories.title: Ab November: Deutsche Bahn führt Familienticket dauerhaft ein

en.title: From November: German Railway introduces family ticket permanently
en.summary: German Railway will offer a family ticket as a permanent fare option starting in November at 99.99 euros for round-trip travel. The railway reported the fixed price was successful during a summer trial.

stories.title: Cornell University: Unipräsident äußert sich nach mutmaßlicher Gruppenvergewaltigung

en.title: Cornell University: University president comments after alleged gang rape
en.summary: The president of the US elite university characterized abuse allegations as concerning and pledged greater transparency to address student concerns.

stories.title: Deutsche Bahn will Familienticket dauerhaft anbieten

en.title: Deutsche Bahn wants to offer family ticket permanently
en.summary: German Railway plans to make its family ticket a permanent offering after initially limiting it to summer. The flat-rate ticket proved successful according to the company's chief.

stories.title: Cornell University: Uni-Präsident bricht Schweigen zu mutmaßlicher Gruppenvergewaltigung

en.title: Cornell University: University president breaks silence on alleged gang rape
en.summary: Cornell University's president addressed the campus community via video regarding allegations that seven students committed rape at a fraternity house. The case has generated significant attention.

en.title: Federal President Steinmeier delivers 51-minute speech for German Unity Day
en.summary: Federal President Steinmeier gave a 51-minute address on the occasion of German Unity Day.

en.title: Russia threatens massive attacks on Kyiv
en.summary: Russia has intensified attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and is warning foreign visitors and diplomats against staying in Kyiv.

stories.title: Nächste Fiesta für Spanien gegen Tschechien

en.title: Next celebration for Spain against Czechia
en.summary: Spain demonstrated dominance over Czechia for at least one half and secured their third consecutive victory in Nations League play.

stories.title: Gegen Tschechien: Spanien feiert Pflichtsieg und baut Serie aus

en.title: Spain celebrates required victory against Czechia and extends winning streak
en.summary: Despite a weaker second half performance, world champion Spain defeated Czechia 3-1, continuing a notable streak.

stories.title: Nation League: England demütigt Kroatien mit 7:0

en.title: Nations League: England humiliates Croatia 7:0
en.summary: Croatia suffered its worst loss in international football history, conceding seven goals to England in a Nations League match. Domestic media compared the team's performance to that of San Marino.

stories.title: Nations League: 7:0! England nimmt Kroatien auseinander

en.title: Nations League: 7:0! England takes Croatia apart
en.summary: England defeated Croatia 7:0 away in a Nations League rematch, with Kane and Saka each scoring twice in the dominant performance.

en.title: Ukraine war: Merz surprisingly traveled to Ukraine: Chancellor arrives in Kyiv in the morning – drone deal planned
en.summary: German Chancellor Merz traveled to Kyiv despite the tense security situation, accompanied by Economy Minister Reiche. Russia had issued a warning beforehand.

en.title: Commentary: Emissions trading – how Brussels extorts industry
en.summary: The EU Commission's proposal to link free certificates with investment obligations is contradictory to the system's principles and based on a critical miscalculation, according to this analysis.

en.summary: Joint investment accounts for ETFs may benefit some couples or partners who already share finances, though individual circumstances determine whether this approach suits each person's needs.

en.summary: The US government supports the startup Joby Aviation in developing an unconventional flying wing aircraft design that offers certain advantages but faces substantial technical and regulatory challenges.

en.title: Gen Z: "Humility Returns – But Not for Everyone"
en.summary: Generation Z's ability to dictate workplace conditions like four-day weeks and remote work is diminishing as job opportunities for entry-level workers shrink significantly.
